component.name: Kurier
component.summary: Start coding agents as subprocesses and drive their sessions

description.p: Kurier is a client for the Agent Client Protocol (ACP), the open standard a coding agent speaks over a JSON-RPC connection on stdio. It starts the agent as a subprocess, keeps its session, and shows you what the agent says while it works.

The agent decides which model does the work; kurier owns the environment around it — which directory the session runs in, what the agent is allowed to do, and which MCP servers it may reach. A session record says what is reachable, never what is allowed, so every request is checked again, every time.

ul.li: Start, list, resume and cancel agent sessions, from the command line or from a window
Watch one prompt turn stream in, and stop it without killing the session
Answer the agent's permission requests yourself — kurier denies by default rather than approving for you
One agent needs no driver: opencode today, anything that speaks ACP tomorrow
